definitionZh: 用不透明的表格填入透明表格。 有时内部不透明的形式变得透明,以保持对比的形状. 这在动画或互动中可以用来传达状态过渡. 范围从0(不治疗)到1(完全填满)。
sourceDefinition: Fill in transparent forms with opaque ones. Sometimes interior opaque forms become transparent, to maintain contrasting shapes. This can be useful in animation or interaction to convey a state transition. Ranges from 0 (no treatment) to 1 (completely filled).
